contradicted: The brief's framing of the geocoder question ('find out whether an empty situs answer falls through to a geocoded point') understates where the damage is. geocoderFallThrough.whatWasFound: two, and the brief only implied one. (1) src/lib/parcel-lookup.ts's envelope ladder — the RAW FIND path — ends in a fuzzy geocode and returns a parcel node id with source 'geocoded'; for an address in an uncovered county it produced a parcel id, i.e. a record identity manufactured from a camera hint. (2) src/lib/geocodeClient.ts's merged typeahead offered a Photon address row where the rows should have been empty.
geocoderFallThrough.whatChanged: the ladder is stopped BEFORE it is called for `county_out_of_coverage` and `out_of_coverage`, and the failure carries the class so the customer reads the county-and-state sentence. The merged typeahead drops the geocode contribution for the same two classes and carries the sentence into the dropdown.
geocoderFallThrough.whatIsDeliberatelyNotStopped: `no-hit` (a covered miss is a legitimate reason to keep looking down the ladder — a normal address can still resolve) and `coverage_check_unavailable` (we do not know, so refusing to look would be a worse failure than the one being fixed). Both are negative controls, run in both directions. When the ladder also fails under an unavailable check, that class replaces the ladder's own prose rather than being reported as a miss.
geocoderFallThrough.bypassesLeftIntact: the parcel-id fast path (an identity is never a coverage question), the Photon geocoder itself (suppressed for these two classes, never consulted for a class), recents, and the MCP's find_parcel half.

threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesTheMissClassOnTheMap: one chain, one reader, one writer of words. cortex's `missClass` (+ outOfCoverageCounty / outOfCoverageState / coverageCheckUnavailableReason) is mapped onto the wire by api/_lib/pe-situs-search-core.ts — mapSitusSearchResponse for an answer cortex gave, coverageUnavailableResponse for an answer we could not obtain. The client reads it in exactly one place, src/lib/coverage-miss.ts coverageMissFromWire, and words it in exactly one place, coverageMissSentence. Three surfaces consume that: the typeahead notice rendered as data-testid=search-coverage-notice in the dropdown; the raw-Find error line (parcel-lookup's coverageMissFailure sets `reason` to the sentence, ExplorerMap puts it in setLookupError, SearchBar renders it as parcel-lookup-error); and the fall-through stop itself, via isOutOfCoverage.
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: an empty situs answer whose body carries a missClass — no-hit, county_out_of_coverage (with the county's FIPS, name and state), out_of_coverage (with the state), coverage_check_unavailable (with a reason). Plus three triggers this lane created or honoured on the BFF's own side, all served as coverage_check_unavailable at HTTP 200: the upstream timeout (9s), a non-ok cortex, a non-JSON body, and a transport failure. It is never triggered by hits, and never invented when no class is present.
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenItIsDroppedAgain: the revert-and-run, item by item: 29 of 50 new assertions go red across 8 files plus 2 collection errors. Customer-visible, that is four different answers collapsing back into one `{"hits":[]}` (the P-205 collapse, reproduced by the 17:10:28 probe on the deployed surface); a fuzzy-geocoded PIN returned as a parcel record for a county we do not cover (`expected true to be false`); a geocoded address row offered in the dropdown for the same address; and a timeout reported as HTTP 502 — which the customer-leg probe grades UNMEASURED, so the failure is not merely wrong, it is unmeasurable.
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: (1) the parcel-id fast path — an id is an identity, never a coverage question, and it makes no network call (asserted); (2) the Photon geocoder — a camera hint, not a coverage source; for the two out-of-coverage classes its rows are suppressed rather than consulted, and it is never asked to answer a coverage question; (3) the MCP's find_parcel half of P-205 — a different repo path, already PASS 4 of 4, untouched; (4) the DROPDOWN-PICK (quiet) path, where a miss shows search-landing.ts's pre-existing OUTSIDE_COVERAGE_CHIP rather than the class's sentence — that file is P-270's and in flight, named in leave_behind; (5) recents and the parcel-id short-circuit in the suggest controller, which cannot produce a coverage answer and are deliberately unmodified; (6) any body that carries hits — the coverage question was never asked, so a class on such a body is ignored by both the BFF and the reader (asserted in both).

DECIDE THE OUTAGE SIGNAL: a cortex outage (timeout, 503, non-JSON body, transport failure) no longer produces a non-200 from /api/pe-situs-search. It now serves HTTP 200 with missClass coverage_check_unavailable and a reason naming the failure ('cortex responded 503', 'cortex timed out after 9000ms'). That reading is what the dispatch asks for, and it is MORE specific than a bare 502 — but anything that pages on this BFF's 5xx stops firing. No monitoring config lives in hauska-map, so this was not verifiable here and is handed over deliberately.

SEARCH-LANDING'S CHIP: on the dropdown-pick (quiet) path a coverage miss still shows search-landing.ts's OUTSIDE_COVERAGE_CHIP rather than the class's sentence. search-landing.ts is P-270's surface and in flight; the class is already carried on the LookupResult, so wiring it is a small follow-on that belongs to whoever owns that file.

TYPEAHEAD LATENCY on a full-ladder miss: 250ms debounce plus the coverage path (3.8s measured for Cameron). Not a gate for this row; it is a question about the coverage source's speed, not about this change, and it is recorded so it is not rediscovered.

`missClassDisplayText`: cortex does not emit it (it is Smart Site MCP vocabulary, smartsite-mcp/src/tool-honesty.ts). The BFF forwards it if a future upstream ever sends one and coverage-miss.ts records it as `displayText`, but the map does NOT prefer it over its own sentence. If upstream starts sending one, preferring it is a decision someone should make explicitly.
